_active_printer_id_comment: Which entry under 'printers' is live. Must name an existing key there.
_beta_features_comment: Enable beta features (e.g., HelixPrint plugin install prompt). Default: false. Always enabled in --test mode.
_config_version_comment: Config schema version. MUST be present and current: Config::init treats a missing version as 0, reads that as a tarball default, and will restore a rolling backup over this file. Pinned by tests/unit/test_settings_template_contract.cpp.
_disable_sound_comment: Disable all sound output. Prevents audio backend initialization entirely. Use on hardware where audio causes excessive CPU load (e.g., Artillery M1 Pro). Also available as --no-sound CLI flag. Default: false.
_log_level_comment: Log verbosity: warn (quiet), info (default), debug, trace. CLI -v flags override this.
_log_path_comment: Log file path when using file destination. Empty = auto (/var/log or ~/.local/share)
_sound_theme_comment: Active sound theme. Loads from config/sounds/<name>.json. Options: 'default', 'minimal'. Default: 'default'.
_sounds_enabled_comment: Master switch for all sound effects. Default: true.
_telemetry_enabled_comment: Enable anonymous usage telemetry. Opt-in during setup wizard. Default: false.
_ui_sounds_enabled_comment: Enable UI interaction sounds (button taps, navigation). Independent of event sounds. Default: true.
_wifi_expected_comment: Whether WiFi connectivity is expected. Used to show connection warnings. Set during wizard.
_wizard_completed_comment: Whether the setup wizard has been completed. Set automatically after first-run wizard.

ams._spool_style_comment: Filament spool visualization style. Options: '3d' (Bambu-style pseudo-3D canvas with gradients), 'flat' (concentric rings). Default is '3d'.

appearance._show_widget_labels_comment: Show text labels below home panel widget icons. Default: false.

cache._disk_critical_mb_comment: Stop caching when available disk falls below this (MB). Prevents filling filesystem. AD5M default: 5
cache._disk_low_mb_comment: Evict aggressively when available disk falls below this (MB). Reduces cache to half normal limit. AD5M default: 20
cache._thumbnail_max_mb_comment: Maximum thumbnail cache size in MB. Auto-sizes to 5% of available disk, clamped to this ceiling. AD5M default: 20

display._animations_enabled_comment: Enable UI animations and transitions. Default: auto-detected from platform capabilities (off on embedded/basic hardware, on for standard).
display._backlight_enable_ioctl_comment: Use BACKLIGHT_ENABLE/DISABLE ioctls for Allwinner display control. Some platforms (e.g. Elegoo CC1, AD5X) invert PWM polarity when these are called; set false for brightness-only control. Default: true.
display._backlight_floor_percent_comment: Lowest brightness level (percent of the panel's raw range) the screen may drop to while on. Some panels render lower levels as black; raise this if the panel goes black before the slider minimum. 0 disables. Default: 0 (20 on K2 builds). Requires restart.
display._bed_mesh_render_mode_comment: Bed mesh visualization mode. 0=3D surface (default), 1=2D heatmap. Default: 0.
display._bed_mesh_show_zero_plane_comment: Show translucent reference plane at Z=0 in bed mesh 3D view. Helps visualize where nozzle touches bed. Default: true.
display._dim_sec_comment: Seconds of inactivity before display dims (0 = no dimming). Default: 600 (10 minutes). Must be less than sleep_sec.
display._drm_device_comment: Override DRM device path (e.g., '/dev/dri/card1'). Empty string enables auto-detection. Pi 5 has multiple DRM cards: card0 (v3d, 3D only), card1 (DSI touchscreen), card2 (vc4/HDMI). Auto-detection finds the first with dumb buffer support and a connected display.
display._gcode_render_mode_comment: G-code visualization mode. 0=Auto, 1=3D GLES, 2=2D Layer (default). Can also be overridden via HELIX_GCODE_MODE env var (3D/2D).
display._screensaver_type_comment: Screensaver during display sleep. 0=Off (blank screen), 1=Flying Toasters, 2=Starfield, 3=3D Pipes. Default: 1, or 0 on low-power hardware. Replaces legacy screensaver_enabled boolean.
display._sleep_backlight_off_comment: Power off backlight during display sleep. Set false only on platforms where backlight power-off is verified to prevent wake-on-touch. When false, software overlay + FBIOBLANK make screen appear off while backlight stays powered. Default: true.
display._sleep_sec_comment: Seconds of inactivity before display turns OFF (0 = never). Default: 1200 (20 minutes).
display._sleep_while_printing_comment: Allow display to dim and sleep during active prints. When false, display stays on while printing. Default: true.
display._theme_comment: Color theme, loaded from assets/config/themes/defaults/<name>.json. Options: ayu, catppuccin, chatgpt, cupertino, dracula, everforest, gruvbox, helixscreen, kanagawa, material-design, midnight, nord, onedark, rose-pine, solarized, tokyonight, yami. Default: 'helixscreen'. Requires restart.
display._time_format_comment: Time display format. 0 = 12-hour (2:30 PM), 1 = 24-hour (14:30). Default is 12-hour.
display._timezone_comment: IANA timezone ID (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Applied via setenv/tzset so all localtime_r() calls produce correct local times. Default: 'UTC'.

filament_sensors._master_enabled_comment: Global toggle to enable/disable all filament sensor monitoring. When false, sensor states are ignored.
filament_sensors._sensors_comment: Array of sensor configurations. Each sensor has: klipper_name (full Klipper object name like 'filament_switch_sensor fsensor'), role ('none', 'runout', 'toolhead', 'entry'), enabled (boolean). Sensors are auto-discovered from Moonraker.

gcode_viewer._adaptive_layer_target_ms_comment: Target render time in milliseconds when using adaptive layers_per_frame (only used when layers_per_frame=0). Lower = smoother UI, higher = faster caching. Default 16ms = ~60 FPS.
gcode_viewer._layers_per_frame_comment: Number of layers to render per frame during progressive 2D visualization. 0 = auto (adaptive based on render time, default), 1-100 = fixed value. Higher = faster caching, but may cause UI stutter on slow devices.
gcode_viewer._streaming_mode_comment: G-code streaming mode for large files. 'auto' (calculate based on RAM), 'on' (always stream), 'off' (always full load). Override with HELIX_GCODE_STREAMING env var.
gcode_viewer._streaming_threshold_percent_comment: Percent of available RAM that triggers streaming mode (1-90). Lower = stream smaller files. Only used when streaming_mode is 'auto'.
gcode_viewer._tube_sides_comment: Number of sides for tube cross-section. Options: 4 (diamond, fastest, default), 8 (octagonal, balanced), 16 (circular, highest quality, matches OrcaSlicer)

input._device_blacklist_comment: List of USB input devices HelixScreen ignores entirely for keyboard/scanner input, as 'vid:pid' lowercase 4-digit hex strings (e.g. ['002c:261a']). Use this when an external barcode scanner tool (like afc-spool-scan) needs the device and HelixScreen keeps grabbing it. Find a device's VID:PID in the Barcode Scanner settings device list, or in helixscreen.log lines '[InputScanner] Found keyboard:' / 'Found USB HID keyboard device:'. Empty list = no blacklist.
input._force_calibration_comment: Force touch calibration on next startup. Automatically cleared after calibration completes. Default: false.
input._scroll_limit_comment: Pixels of movement before scrolling starts. Lower = more responsive. Default LVGL is 10, we use 10 to match.
input._scroll_throw_comment: Scroll momentum decay rate (1-99). Higher = faster decay. Default LVGL is 10, we use 25 for better touchpad feel.
input._touch_device_comment: Override touch/pointer input device (e.g., '/dev/input/event1'). Empty string enables auto-detection. Auto-detection finds touch or pointer capable devices.

calibration._comment: Touch calibration coefficients. Set by calibration wizard or manually.

label_printer._address_comment: Network address (IP or hostname) for network label printers.
label_printer._bt_comment: Bluetooth address, name, and transport (spp or ble) for Bluetooth label printers.
label_printer._label_count_comment: Number of labels to print per job. Default: 1.
label_printer._label_size_comment: Label size preset index. 0 = default size for printer model.
label_printer._port_comment: Network port for label printer. Default: 9100 (RAW/JetDirect).
label_printer._type_comment: Label printer connection type. Options: 'network', 'usb', 'bluetooth'. Default: 'network'.
label_printer._usb_comment: USB vendor ID, product ID, and serial for USB label printers. 0 = auto-detect.

output._led_on_at_start_comment: Automatically turn on the configured LED when Klipper becomes ready. Default: false.

plugins._enabled_comment: List of plugin IDs to load. Plugins must be explicitly enabled. Example: ["led-effects"]

printers._per_printer_comment: Each configured printer is an object here keyed by id (e.g. 'default', 'printer-2'), holding that machine's own moonraker_host/port, heaters, temp_sensors, fans, leds, hardware, panel_widgets, preset, toolhead_style, and detection/policy_u1. 'active_printer_id' at the root selects which one is live. Keys directly under 'printers' that are not objects (like show_printer_switcher) are install-wide settings, not printers.
printers._show_printer_switcher_comment: Show the printer switcher button on the home panel. Default: false.

default._chamber_heater_comment: Chamber heater assignment. 'auto' (detect by name heuristics), 'none' (disable), or Klipper object name (e.g., 'heater_generic chamber'). Default: 'auto'.
default._chamber_sensor_comment: Chamber temperature sensor assignment. 'auto' (detect by name heuristics), 'none' (disable), or Klipper object name (e.g., 'temperature_sensor enclosure_bme'). Default: 'auto'.

capability_overrides._comment: Override auto-detected printer capabilities. Values: 'auto' (use detection), 'enable' (force on), 'disable' (force off). Use 'enable' for features that work but weren't detected (e.g., heat_soak without chamber heater).
capability_overrides.speaker: auto

default_macros.cooldown:
SET_HEATER_TEMPERATURE HEATER=extruder TARGET=0
SET_HEATER_TEMPERATURE HEATER=heater_bed TARGET=0

filament._cooldown_delay_seconds_comment: Seconds to wait after a filament operation before turning off the extruder heater. Default: 120 (2 minutes). Set to 0 to disable auto-cooldown. Per-printer: read as printers/<id>/filament/cooldown_delay_seconds.

heaters._hotend_comment: Primary extruder heater. Additional extruders (extruder1, extruder2, etc.) are auto-discovered from Klipper. Toolchangers and multi-backend AMS systems are also auto-detected. No manual configuration needed for multi-extruder or multi-tool setups.

leds._color_presets_comment: Preset colors (#RRGGBB) shown in the color picker. Default: white, red, green, blue, yellow, magenta, cyan.
leds._last_brightness_comment: Last used brightness percentage (0-100). Remembered between sessions.
leds._last_color_comment: Last used LED color as #RRGGBB hex string (also accepts legacy integer RGB). Remembered between sessions.
leds._led_on_at_start_comment: Automatically turn on selected LED strips when Klipper becomes ready. Default: false.
leds._macro_devices_comment: Custom LED macro devices shown as cards in LED control overlay. Each: {name, type (on_off|toggle|preset), on_macro, off_macro, toggle_macro, presets}.
leds._selected_strips_comment: Klipper LED strip IDs to control (e.g., ["neopixel caselight"]). Configured via Settings > LED Settings.
leds._startup_brightness_comment: Brightness percentage (1-100) used when LEDs turn on at startup. Default: 80.
leds._strip_comment: Legacy single LED strip name. Superseded by selected_strips for multi-strip control.

auto_state._comment: Automatic state-based LED lighting. Actions: off, brightness, color, effect, wled_preset, macro.

default.name: C308L Printer

safety_limits._comment: Safety limits for G-code generation. Explicit values override Moonraker auto-detection. Defaults are conservative for most FDM printers. High-temp printers may need max_temperature_celsius > 400. Leave unset to auto-detect from printer.cfg via Moonraker.

safety._cancel_escalation_enabled_comment: Enable cancel-to-E-Stop escalation. When enabled, rapidly pressing cancel multiple times triggers an emergency stop. Default: false.
safety._cancel_escalation_timeout_seconds_comme: Window in seconds for cancel escalation to trigger E-Stop. Default: 30.
safety._estop_require_confirmation_comment: Require confirmation dialog before emergency stop. When false, E-Stop triggers immediately. Default: true (confirmation required).

security._auto_lock_comment: Automatically lock screen on sleep/wake. Requires pin_hash to be set. Default: false.
security._pin_hash_comment: SHA-256 hash of lock screen PIN. Empty = no lock screen. Set via Settings > Security.

standard_macros._comment: Controls panel quick-action button assignments. Built-in options: 'clean_nozzle', 'bed_level', 'heat_soak', 'purge', 'bed_mesh'. Empty string hides the button.

streaming._force_streaming_comment: Always use streaming operations regardless of file size. Useful for memory-constrained devices or testing. Can also be set via HELIX_FORCE_STREAMING=1 env var.
streaming._threshold_mb_comment: File size threshold in MB for using streaming (disk-based) operations instead of buffered (in-memory). 0 = auto-detect based on 10% of available RAM. Override with HELIX_FORCE_STREAMING=1 env var to force streaming for all files.

update._dev_url_comment: Base URL for dev channel manifest. Set to enable Dev channel option.

upgrade_nudge._dismissed_version_comment: Auto-maintained. The version the user dismissed the banner for; resets on each new detected release.
upgrade_nudge._intensity_comment: In-app upgrade nudging intensity. 'off' = no in-app prompt beyond the Settings > About entry. 'normal' = red dot on Settings icon when an update is available. 'aggressive' = persistent dismissible top-banner for the 1.0 rollout. Default 'off' until 1.0 ships.
